question: How many customers does the store have?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers FROM chinook.customer

question: How many tracks are there?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS tracks FROM chinook.track

question: How many employees are there?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS employees FROM chinook.employee

question: What is the total revenue from all invoices?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(total) AS revenue FROM chinook.invoice

question: How many playlists are there?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS playlists FROM chinook.playlist

question: How many customers are from Brazil?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers FROM chinook.customer WHERE country = 'Brazil'

question: Which 5 genres have the most tracks?
gold_sql: SELECT g.name AS genre, COUNT(*) AS tracks FROM chinook.track t JOIN chinook.genre g ON g.genre_id = t.genre_id GROUP BY g.name ORDER BY tracks DESC LIMIT 5

question: Which 5 billing countries bring the most revenue?
gold_sql: SELECT billing_country, SUM(total) AS revenue FROM chinook.invoice GROUP BY billing_country ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 5

question: How many customers does each sales support rep look after?
gold_sql: SELECT e.first_name || ' ' || e.last_name AS sales_rep, COUNT(*) AS customers FROM chinook.customer c JOIN chinook.employee e ON e.employee_id = c.support_rep_id GROUP BY e.employee_id, e.first_name, e.last_name ORDER BY customers DESC

question: What is the average invoice total in each year?
gold_sql: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM invoice_date)::int AS year, AVG(total) AS avg_total FROM chinook.invoice GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

question: Which 10 artists earned the most revenue?
gold_sql: SELECT ar.name AS artist, SUM(il.unit_price * il.quantity) AS revenue FROM chinook.invoice_line il JOIN chinook.track t ON t.track_id = il.track_id JOIN chinook.album al ON al.album_id = t.album_id JOIN chinook.artist ar ON ar.artist_id = al.artist_id GROUP BY ar.name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 10

question: How many tracks have never been bought?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS tracks FROM chinook.track t WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM chinook.invoice_line il WHERE il.track_id = t.track_id)

question: How many tracks are there for each media type?
gold_sql: SELECT mt.name AS media_type, COUNT(*) AS tracks FROM chinook.track t JOIN chinook.media_type mt ON mt.media_type_id = t.media_type_id GROUP BY mt.name ORDER BY tracks DESC

question: Which 5 genres bring the most revenue?
gold_sql: SELECT g.name AS genre, SUM(il.unit_price * il.quantity) AS revenue FROM chinook.invoice_line il JOIN chinook.track t ON t.track_id = il.track_id JOIN chinook.genre g ON g.genre_id = t.genre_id GROUP BY g.name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 5

question: Which customers have spent more than 45 dollars in total?
gold_sql: SELECT c.first_name || ' ' || c.last_name AS customer, SUM(i.total) AS spent FROM chinook.customer c JOIN chinook.invoice i ON i.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name HAVING SUM(i.total) > 45 ORDER BY spent DESC

question: Who is the highest-spending customer in each country? Keep ties.
gold_sql: WITH s AS (SELECT c.country, c.first_name || ' ' || c.last_name AS customer, SUM(i.total) AS spent FROM chinook.customer c JOIN chinook.invoice i ON i.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.country, c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name), r AS (SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY spent DESC) AS rnk FROM s) SELECT country, customer, spent FROM r WHERE rnk = 1 ORDER BY country, customer

question: How many levels below the top manager is each employee?
gold_sql: WITH RECURSIVE org AS (SELECT employee_id, first_name || ' ' || last_name AS employee, 0 AS level FROM chinook.employee WHERE reports_to IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT e.employee_id, e.first_name || ' ' || e.last_name, o.level + 1 FROM chinook.employee e JOIN org o ON e.reports_to = o.employee_id) SELECT employee, level FROM org ORDER BY level, employee

question: Which customers have bought tracks from at least 10 different genres?
gold_sql: SELECT c.first_name || ' ' || c.last_name AS customer, COUNT(DISTINCT t.genre_id) AS genres FROM chinook.customer c JOIN chinook.invoice i ON i.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN chinook.invoice_line il ON il.invoice_id = i.invoice_id JOIN chinook.track t ON t.track_id = il.track_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT t.genre_id) >= 10 ORDER BY genres DESC, customer

question: For each month of 2024, what was the revenue and the change from the previous month (December 2023 for January)?
gold_sql: WITH m AS (SELECT date_trunc('month', invoice_date)::date AS month, SUM(total) AS revenue FROM chinook.invoice GROUP BY 1), c AS (SELECT month, revenue, revenue - LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS change FROM m) SELECT month, revenue, change FROM c WHERE month >= '2024-01-01' AND month < '2025-01-01' ORDER BY month

question: What is the largest number of different artists on a single playlist?
gold_sql: SELECT MAX(artists) AS max_artists FROM (SELECT pt.playlist_id, COUNT(DISTINCT al.artist_id) AS artists FROM chinook.playlist_track pt JOIN chinook.track t ON t.track_id = pt.track_id JOIN chinook.album al ON al.album_id = t.album_id GROUP BY pt.playlist_id) p
